content: This paper presents a novel methodology for joint feature selection and classification of functional data with categorical responses, integrating logistic loss and functional features to identify key features for classification. Utilizing functional principal components and an adaptive version of the Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm, the method efficiently addresses high-dimensional data scenarios, as demonstrated through simulations and a real data application involving chronic diseases and health factors.
